title: Soft Gradient
look: No outline: every piece has a vertical gradient, a glow of the character's colour behind it, eyes with a shine.

doc.essence: Friendly product-mascot vector lit from above: no outline, every piece a vertical gradient, a glow of the character's colour behind it on a dark stage.
doc.notIt: Not glassy (no reflections), not 3D (no shading beyond the gradient).
doc.shapes: No outline: edges come from colour contrast, so neighbouring parts need different roles. Details that would vanish (an envelope's lid edges) are drawn as thin lines.
doc.colour: Volume roles get a gradient from 34 % lighter (12 % for belly) down to the role colour. Stage #15121F with a radial glow; ink-coloured props turn light.
doc.eyes: Dark ovals with a white shine; cheeks always faintly visible (0.45).
doc.motion: Smooth; the ground shadow narrows as the character rises.
pitfalls: Gradients on thin strokes break (zero-width box): stroke limbs use flat colours.
A paper-white body looks unfinished here: tune it with palettes['@no-outline'].
